the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 50 (open, price, submit).
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 0 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” equals 1.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” equals 1.
